t0: Tell a step which files its tests write, and Launchway reads them when the step ends, whether it passed or failed:
t1:
steps:
  test:
    image: python:3.12
    run: pytest --junitxml=reports/unit.xml
    reports:
      tests: reports/*.xml

        paths: test-results/results.json
        attachments: test-results
